thread:
morgan: Quick check — where are the final weights for model-phi v2? Need them for the onboard canary tomorrow.

devin: s3://redwood-models/phi/v2/weights/phi-v2-20260214-9f2a.tar.gz :point_right: checksum 9f2a7b...

sam: heads up — tokenizer has a merge rule difference vs phi-v1. We need to set `tokenizer_normalize=true` in the catalog config or some prompts will split emojis.

morgan: @sam can you paste the minimal config snippet? I want to include it in the rollout PR.

sam: sure —
```
model_version: "phi-v2"
weights_uri: "s3://redwood-models/phi/v2/weights/phi-v2-20260214-9f2a.tar.gz"
tokenizer:
  name: "phi-tokenizer"
  normalize: true
pin_policy: "strict"
fallback_variants: ["phi-v1-quantized"]
canary:
  percent: 5
  regions: ["us-west-2", "eu-west-1"]
```

ci-bot: config-lint: ERROR in catalog/phi-v2.yaml: missing field `eos_token` — see docs/format.md:line 42 :warning: 

anya: I can add eos/bos tokens. Which values do we want? phi-v1 used `<|start|>` and `<|end|>` historically.

devin: use `<s>` and `</s>` for phi-v2, we normalized the vocab. Sam, confirm this won't break previous evals.

sam: confirmed — tests pass locally after setting tokenizer normalize + eos/bos. I pushed a tiny patch, pinged frank for CR.

li: operational note — ops-bot, please enable region `ap-northeast-1` for the canary only after we hit green on staging. We don't want traffic in APAC yet. :eyes: 

ops-bot: Received. Prechecks: capacity ok for 5% canary in us-west-2/eu-west-1. APAC pending. Run `./scripts/enable-region --model phi-v2 --region ap-northeast-1` once staging is green.

morgan: plan: 1) fix lint (anya) 2) merge CR (frank) 3) run canary @ 5% in us-west-2/eu-west-1 4) monitor + escalate. If latency regresses >20% fallback to `phi-v1-quantized`.

devin: small ask — please add `quant_profile: q4_0` to the catalog for the quant fallback.

sam: done in my patch. Frank you saw?

frank: (in PR) LGTM, will merge after CI green.

morgan: thanks team — I'll schedule the canary and add the rollout steps to the ticket. :thumbsup:
